details.message: The resource write operation failed to complete successfully, because it reached terminal provisioning state 'Failed'.

We have a temporary capacity issue with Application Gateways in this region/zone. Please retry after a few days or please try the operation in another region or zone. For a list of Azure regions, refer to: https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/global-infrastructure/regions/.
